A [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''warrior''' lived on his home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. The warrior encountered the [[madclaw]] [[Zaalbar]] in [[3954 BBY]], when Zaalbar was traveling with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], and he refused to allow the group to access the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] without the permission of their tribe's chief, [[Chuundar]].
